top.convention: OpenCV pinhole: x right, y down, z forward. A camera-frame point (X, Y, Z) projects to continuous image coordinates u = fx*X/Z + cx, v = fy*Y/Z + cy; the pixel in column i, row j covers u in [i, i+1), v in [j, j+1) and samples its centre (u, v) = (i + 0.5, j + 0.5).
